data_fields.name: stack_size
data_fields.donor_constant: per item via item.stackSize() (definition not read)

data_fields.name: take_from_bag_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: min(requested, stackSize of the top item)

best_idea: Make every inventory change a server-run command that checks the whole outcome first, fills partial stacks before opening an empty slot, and keeps the bag as a LIFO list of same-item runs.
decision_why: Keep the check-then-apply command shape, fill-partial-first and the canHold precheck; fix the removeItems under-charge and the unclamped create, and clamp bag slots, before use.
acceptance: A server test crafts a recipe needing 100 of an item with stack 64 held in two full stacks; the server removes exactly 100 and rejects a craft whose result cannot fit without removing any ingredient.
